records.text: Danuta Kozák, Hungarian kayaker, was born on January 11, 1987.
records.textJa: Danuta Kozák（Hungarian kayaker）は1987年1月11日に生まれた。

records.text: Lisa Carrington, New Zealand canoeist, was born on June 23, 1989.
records.textJa: Lisa Carrington（New Zealand canoeist）は1989年6月23日に生まれた。

records.eventLabel: canoeing at the 2016 Summer Olympics – men's K-1 1000 metres
records.text: On August 16, 2016, canoeing at the 2016 Summer Olympics – men's K-1 1000 metres took place in Lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas.

records.text: On August 20, 2025, the 2025 ICF Canoe Sprint World Championships began.
